import ast,os,json,pathlib
root=pathlib.Path('/home/moloch/jacobian-lens/research/confirmation_2026-09-09')
spec=json.loads((root/'bundle/frozen/run_spec.json').read_text()); expected=spec['original_precision']
for k,v in expected['environment'].items():
 if v is None:os.environ.pop(k,None)
 else:os.environ[k]=v
import torch
torch.set_num_threads(8);torch.set_num_interop_threads(1)
fn=next(n for n in ast.parse((root/'bundle/legacy/run_refits.py').read_text()).body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='_precision')
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[fn],type_ignores=[]),'pinned_precision','exec'))
worker=ast.parse((root/'corrections/precision_v1/bundle/evaluation/worker.py').read_text())
gate=next(n for n in ast.walk(worker) if isinstance(n,ast.If) and ast.unparse(n.test)=="runtime['precision'] != spec['original_precision']")
def rejects(value):
 try:exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[gate],type_ignores=[]),'actual_corrected_gate','exec'),{'runtime':{'precision':value},'spec':spec})
 except ValueError:return True
 return False
before=_precision(torch);assert before==expected;assert not rejects(before)
torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32=False
torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32=True
after=_precision(torch);assert after!=expected;assert rejects(after)
diff=[{'field':f'matmul.{k}','before':before['matmul'][k],'after':v} for k,v in after['matmul'].items() if before['matmul'][k]!=v]
assert len(diff)==1 and diff[0]['field']=='matmul.fp32_precision';rest=dict(after);rest['matmul']=dict(before['matmul']);assert rest==before
assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
print(json.dumps({'torch_version':torch.__version__,'cuda_initialized':torch.cuda.is_initialized(),'corrected_defaults_match_entire_original_precision':True,'actual_corrected_gate_accepts_defaults':True,'original_setters_fail_entire_precision_equality':True,'actual_corrected_gate_rejects_original_setter_result':True,'differences':diff,'before':before,'after':after}))
